User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user in the system with their authentication ID, email, and assigned role.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity, typically the Firebase Authentication User ID (UID).

email.description: The email address associated with the user's account.

role.description: The role of the user within the system (e.g., Admin, Instructor, Accountant).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user record was last updated.

createdBy.description: Reference to the User who created this user record. (Relationship: User 1:N User)

Student.title: Student
Student.description: Represents a student enrolled in the driving school, including personal details, course information, and financial status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Student entity.

userId.description: Reference to the associated User entity for authentication purposes. (Relationship: User 1:1 Student)

fullName.description: The full name of the student.

courseType.description: The type of driving course the student is enrolled in.

registrationDate.description: The date when the student registered for the course.

assignedInstructorId.description: Reference to the Instructor assigned to this student. (Relationship: Instructor 1:N Student)

totalFee.description: The total fee for the student's course.

paidAmount.description: The total amount paid by the student so far.

dueAmount.description: The remaining amount due from the student (auto-calculated).

status.description: The current status of the student (e.g., Active, Completed).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the student record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the student record was last updated.

createdBy.description: Reference to the User who created this student record. (Relationship: User 1:N Student)

Instructor.title: Instructor
Instructor.description: Represents a driving instructor, including personal details, contact information, and salary structure.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Instructor entity.

userId.description: Reference to the associated User entity for authentication purposes. (Relationship: User 1:1 Instructor)

name.description: The full name of the instructor.

salaryType.description: The type of salary payment (e.g., Fixed, Per Student).

salaryAmount.description: The amount for the instructor's salary, interpreted based on salaryType.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the instructor record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the instructor record was last updated.

createdBy.description: Reference to the User who created this instructor record. (Relationship: User 1:N Instructor)

Vehicle.title: Vehicle
Vehicle.description: Represents a vehicle used by the driving school, including its registration and maintenance details.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Vehicle entity.

vehicleName.description: The make and model name of the vehicle.

insuranceExpiry.description: The expiry date of the vehicle's insurance policy.

serviceDueDate.description: The next due date for vehicle service.

status.description: The current operational status of the vehicle (e.g., Available, In Service, Under Repair).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the vehicle record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the vehicle record was last updated.

createdBy.description: Reference to the User who created this vehicle record. (Relationship: User 1:N Vehicle)

Class.title: Class
Class.description: Represents a scheduled driving class, linking a student, an instructor, and tracking class details.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Class entity.

studentId.description: Reference to the Student attending this class. (Relationship: Student 1:N Class)

instructorId.description: Reference to the Instructor teaching this class. (Relationship: Instructor 1:N Class)

date.description: The date when the class is scheduled.

time.description: The scheduled time for the class (e.g., 'HH:MM AM/PM').

attendanceStatus.description: The attendance status for the class (e.g., Present, Absent, Canceled).

notes.description: Any additional notes or remarks for the class.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the class record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the class record was last updated.

createdBy.description: Reference to the User who created this class record. (Relationship: User 1:N Class)

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Records individual payment transactions made by students.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Payment entity.

studentId.description: Reference to the Student who made the payment. (Relationship: Student 1:N Payment)

amount.description: The amount of the payment made.

paymentDate.description: The date when the payment was received.

paymentMethod.description: The method of payment (e.g., Cash, Card, Bank Transfer).

receiptNumber.description: A unique identifier or number for the payment receipt.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the payment record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the payment record was last updated.

createdBy.description: Reference to the User who created this payment record. (Relationship: User 1:N Payment)

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: Records individual expenses incurred by the driving school.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Expense entity.

category.description: The category of the expense (e.g., Fuel, Salary, Maintenance, Office).

amount.description: The monetary amount of the expense.

expenseDate.description: The date when the expense was incurred.

description.description: A brief description of the expense.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the expense record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the expense record was last updated.

createdBy.description: Reference to the User who created this expense record. (Relationship: User 1:N Expense)

BackupMetadata.title: BackupMetadata
BackupMetadata.description: Stores metadata about each successful or attempted Firestore data backup to Google Drive.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BackupMetadata entity.

fileName.description: The name of the backup file stored in Google Drive (e.g., backup_YYYY_MM_DD.json).

googleDriveFileId.description: The unique ID of the backup file within Google Drive.

backupDate.description: The timestamp when the backup operation was completed.

status.description: The status of the backup operation (e.g., 'Completed', 'Failed', 'Pending').

sizeBytes.description: The size of the backup file in bytes.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the backup metadata record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the backup metadata record was last updated.

createdBy.description: Reference to the User (typically an Admin) who initiated this backup. (Relationship: User 1:N BackupMetadata)

definition.description: Stores user profiles and their assigned roles. The document ID (`{userId}`) matches the Firebase Authentication UID, which allows direct role lookup for security rules. Includes denormalized 'role' for authorization independence.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication User ID (UID) of the user.

Includes denormalized 'userId' (same as document ID) for student's self-access and 'assignedInstructorId' for instructor's access, ensuring authorization independence.

params.name: studentId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication User ID (UID) of the student.

definition.description: Manages records for all driving instructors. The document ID (`{instructorId}`) matches the Firebase Authentication UID of the associated instructor user. Includes denormalized 'userId' (same as document ID) for instructor's self-access, ensuring authorization independence.

params.name: instructorId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication User ID (UID) of the instructor.

definition.description: Contains details about the driving school's vehicles. Access is typically restricted to Admin roles.

params.name: vehicleId
params.description: The unique identifier for the vehicle.

definition.description: Schedules and tracks individual driving classes. Includes denormalized 'studentId' and 'instructorId' for authorization independence, allowing direct access checks without parent document lookups for students and instructors.

params.name: classId
params.description: The unique identifier for the class.

definition.description: Records all payment transactions made by students. Includes denormalized 'studentId' for authorization independence, allowing students to access their own payment history directly.

params.name: paymentId
params.description: The unique identifier for the payment record.

definition.description: Logs all operational expenses of the driving school. Access is typically restricted to Accountant and Admin roles.

params.name: expenseId
params.description: The unique identifier for the expense record.

definition.description: Stores metadata about each Google Drive backup operation. Access is strictly restricted to Admin roles.

params.name: backupId
params.description: The unique identifier for the backup metadata record.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to be secure, scalable, and easily debuggable, prioritizing authorization independence and query-after-permission (QAP) principles. Each top-level collection represents a distinct entity, ensuring structural segregation and homogeneous security postures. Authorization roles (Admin, Instructor, Accountant) are stored directly within the `/users/{userId}` document, making role-based access control (DBAC) straightforward using `request.auth.uid` to fetch the user's role. This avoids the complexity and debugging challenges associated with custom claims.

**Authorization Independence:** To eliminate `get()` calls in security rules and enable atomic operations, key authorization contexts are denormalized. For instance:
*   In `/students/{studentId}`, the `userId` (which is the student's Firebase Auth UID, also used as the document ID) and `assignedInstructorId` fields are explicitly stored. This allows a student to directly access their own record (`request.auth.uid == studentId`) and an instructor to query for their assigned students (`assignedInstructorId == request.auth.uid`) without needing to fetch a parent document.
*   Similarly, `/instructors/{instructorId}` documents store the `userId` (the instructor's Firebase Auth UID and document ID), enabling direct self-access.
*   In `/classes/{classId}`, both `studentId` and `instructorId` are denormalized into each class document. This allows students to list their specific classes (`studentId == request.auth.uid`) and instructors to list their assigned classes (`instructorId == request.auth.uid`) directly, fulfilling QAP requirements for `list` operations without relying on slow or insecure cross-document lookups.
*   Payments in `/payments/{paymentId}` also include `studentId` for direct student and accountant access.

**Query-After-Permission (QAP):** The structure facilitates secure `list` operations by embedding the necessary authorization fields directly into the documents. This means security rules can check document-level attributes (`request.auth.uid == resource.data.ownerId`, `request.auth.uid in resource.data.members`, `request.auth.uid == resource.data.studentId`, `request.auth.uid == resource.data.instructorId`) without needing to filter client-side or use expensive `get()` calls that would break QAP. Collections like `/vehicles`, `/expenses`, and `/backupMetadata` are primarily managed by specific roles (Admin/Accountant), making their `list` operations inherently secure based on the requesting user's role found in their `/users/{userId}` profile.

All documents consistently include `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, and `createdBy` fields, supporting audit trails and invariant checks for ownership and data integrity. Path parameters are explicitly named (e.g., `{userId}`, `{studentId}`), enhancing clarity and debuggability of security rules.
